limitations: Bucket membership is inferred from nearest supplied surfaces, not ground-truth segmentation.
Original front-view PSNR remains slightly below the previous model, despite clearer bucket geometry and higher source-view structural similarity.
Arm and other parts retain their existing artifacts.
GPU render timing and the short stream probe do not establish long-term browser display FPS.
Source poses and all 399 original video frames are production supervision, not held-out geometry or time.

benchmark.scope: Single-process GPU render plus RGB uint8 CPU transfer; excludes encoding, SSH, browser presentation; no end-to-end FPS guarantee

invariants.scope: Saved-parameter equality and numerical rigid-motion invariant; does not establish photometric quality or correctness of inferred bucket segmentation

storage.method: Fixed Gaussian count; bounded 399 pose samples and 48 color knots; no growing per-frame cache; publish by move and backlink; old model retained
